name: Brambleblade Ravine
summary: Bristleback quilboar raid Camp Narache from Brambleblade Ravine, cut into Red Cloud Mesa’s northeastern edge. Young tauren braves enter the ravine to defend their homeland and prove their strength.

sections.title: A Thorn in the Mesa's Side
sections.body: Brambleblade Ravine cuts into Red Cloud Mesa’s northeastern edge, its thorny briars and quilboar camps guarding the Bristleback tribe. From this den, the Bristlebacks raid Camp Narache and threaten young tauren coming of age. Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the shamans and warriors who dwell deep in the ravine with trained battleboars. For the Shu'halo, striking into the canyon is both a rite of passage and a hard need if the plains are to be safe.

faq.answer: Brambleblade Ravine cuts into the northeastern edge of Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Bristleback quilboar hold it as a stronghold.

faq.q: Why are the Bristleback quilboar attacking from here?
faq.answer: The Bristlebacks claim the lands around Brambleblade Ravine and see the tauren as intruders. They raid nearby Camp Narache from the ravine.

faq.q: Who leads the quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine?
faq.answer: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine. He lives in a large hut toward the ravine’s back.

faq.q: Why do young tauren travel to the ravine?
faq.answer: Tauren elders and chieftains at Camp Narache send young braves into the ravine to push back the Bristlebacks, reduce their numbers, and defeat their leaders to keep the mesa safe.

angles.text: As a young tauren coming of age at Camp Narache, you face one of your first tests of martial and spiritual endurance when you strike into Brambleblade Ravine to defend your tribe.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure its early foothold across Mulgore by clearing the aggressive Bristlebacks from Brambleblade Ravine.
